project_fields.Objective: Make tier+effort a first-class priced resolvable lever

source_artifact.content_excerpt: Slug pf-spend-gate-asymmetry consolidates four survivor facets from the 2026-07-03 plugin-fleet ideation round (theme T12, spend-approval-asymmetry / recommendation-quality / lever-placement axes): a shared spend_delta(old,new) classifier deriving silent-cheap/ask-expensive tier ordering (T12-F4-3, primary), a mandatory 'worth it, because...' + named cheaper-fallback field on every above-baseline tier row (T12-F1-3), a relative one-notch-cheaper/dearer override lever in place of an absolute tier re-pick (T12-F3-6), and an optional per-repo .saga/spend-authority.json delegation-of-authority matrix with a safe absent-matrix default (T12-F5-3). All four reuse the existing ordered MODELS/EFFORTS ladder in plugins/saga/scripts/execution_spec.py that segment_units() already trusts.
source_artifact.title: Spend-delta machinery: silent-cheap/ask-expensive classifier, worth-it receipts, relative lever, and spend authority
